Find the coordinates $(h,k)$ of the center of the circle above given that the points $(6,-4)$ and $(2,4)$ lie on a diameter of the circle.

$(h,k)=(${{field-1}}$,${{field-2}}$)$
worked_solution:
The center of the circle is located at the midpoint of the diameter. Therefore, we can calculate it using the midpoint formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}(h,k) & =(\frac{{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}}{2},\frac{{y}_{1}+{y}_{2}}{2}) \\  & =(\frac{6+2}{2},\frac{-4+4}{2}) \\  & =(\frac{8}{2},\frac{0}{2}) \\  & =(4,0)\end{aligned}
$$
